support.faqPaymentsA1: From Buy packages choose your school's package and pay by card: your lessons are available right after payment.
support.faqPaymentsA2: Yes. Each package is valid for a number of days from purchase, shown on its card, and only at the school where you bought it.

hero.lead: The European network exclusively celebrating adult ballet dancers, certified master teachers, and boutique studios. Rediscover grace, postural freedom, and joyful discipline.

stats.studentsNote: Taking centre stage at every age

roles.title: Built for Every Role
roles.lead: One unified European ballet platform with four tailor-crafted portals. Built with empathy for dancers, teachers, and academies.
roles.dancersBody: Book classes effortlessly, switch between cities seamlessly, and practise at home with on-demand video masterclasses.
roles.teachersBody: Devote yourself entirely to your students. Digital attendance, automated compensation, and the Alina Quintana syllabus.
roles.studiosBody: Fill your morning and evening barre slots with committed adult students. Complete billing, room scheduling, and reporting.
roles.hqBody: Pan-European governance ensuring every certified studio delivers authentic posture safety, pedagogical joy, and artistic excellence.

cities.title: Dance Where You Live & Travel
cities.lead: Your membership travels with you. Book a barre in Milano on Monday and attend a Barcelona workshop on Friday.
cities.empty: The network map is being prepared. Studios will appear here as they join.
cities.horizonLead: New studios are opening as the network grows. Join the early priority waitlist.

steps.title: Start Dancing in 3 Simple Steps
steps.lead: No auditions. No intimidating dress codes. Just classical joy curated for your body, pace, and schedule.
steps.s1Body: Whether you have zero prior dance experience or are returning after twenty years away from the barre, we match you with a warm, judgement-free group.
steps.s2Body: Select a verified studio in your city. Filter by morning energiser barre, evening deep stretch, or weekend masterclass repertoire.
steps.s3Body: Book a single trial pass or flexible multi-class credits with full cancellation flexibility. Arrive in comfortable attire and begin transforming your posture.

board.title: Today & Tomorrow at the Barre

cta.studentsTitle: Ready to Step Onto the Floor?
cta.studentsBody: Your first adult ballet lesson is one click away. Join a room filled with music, support, laughter, and zero intimidation.
cta.schoolsBody: Bring certified adult pedagogy to your city. Access student demand, pedagogical standards, and our software suite.

footer.about: The international adult ballet network, uniting elegance, anatomical grace, and artistic joy for dancers of every age. Classical dance designed for adult bodies.
